actual_missing_episode_assessment.explanation: The current bounded API proves later completed AIR episodes existed and were not persisted for these rows. It does not reveal whether additional episodes occurred in the interval already aged out before the failed poll.

root_cause.primary: The bounded current regionHistory window moved beyond the last committed poll boundary because bridge/checkpoint state was coupled to the later dashboard commit. Multiple later workflow failures prevented successful intermediate bridge polls from becoming durable.
root_cause.real_data_gap_A: not established for the seam; only a proof gap is established
root_cause.note: The existing poll-overlap test is conservative and correct for a bounded moving history window. The architecture failed to persist verified checkpoints before unrelated later failures.

constraints: Persist a city continuity watermark only after that city's overlap has been verified.
Persist raw fetched observations independently even if later dashboard verification fails.
Do not mark a city continuous merely because a fetch succeeded.

option_2_alternate_watermark.reason: A retained event match or later event overlap does not prove that no unseen alert occurred between the previous poll and the bounded current history. Use only a watermark/source that proves every part of the interval.

option_3_one_time_seam_recovery.source: alerts.in.ua exact-location history or daily CSV export
validation: Use only UID/location 1293 for Kharkiv exact hromada, 98 for Mykolaiv raion, and 114 for Sumy raion.
Cover from the previous committed last_checked_at through at least the failed poll/current official overlap.
Cross-check overlapping Alerts.in.ua and UkraineAlarm episodes with the existing deterministic timestamp tolerance before restoring continuity.
After repair, resume unchanged poll-overlap continuity.

option_4_deeper_regionHistory.reason: Official v3 documentation describes regionHistory as the last 25 alerts and documents only regionId; no deterministic pagination/depth parameter was verified.

safest_minimal_repair.immediate: Fetch/export alerts.in.ua exact-location history for the three targets, cover the entire conservative recovery intervals, validate overlap against UkraineAlarm, append only verified completed AIR episodes, then restore the continuity checkpoint and rerun production verification.
safest_minimal_repair.durable_follow_up: Persist verified per-city bridge checkpoints/raw poll observations immediately after the bridge step so later dashboard/casualty/verification failures cannot erase continuity evidence.

readiness.blocker: Exact failed-run oldest_history_start/latest_history_end were not retained for mykolaiv and sumy. A new alerts.in.ua exact-location history/CSV fetch is required to close those seams; the forensic must not fabricate those timestamps.
